verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for a SaaS marketing platform with a public API, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents sandbox accounts, developer test portals, or any other isolated environment separate from production data. The API, email-editor and MCP-server items cover other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
